name: openspec_finalize
description: Mark verified OpenSpec tasks complete, validate, archive the change on a run-specific branch, and commit lifecycle artifacts.

writebackRepoPath.description: Absolute path to the git repository to archive the OpenSpec change in and commit against.

writebackProjectPath.description: Absolute path to the OpenSpec project root (the directory containing openspec/) inside writebackRepoPath's checkout.

changeId.description: OpenSpec change identifier to complete and archive.

branchRunId.description: Run identifier used to build the default archive branch name; takes precedence over workflowId.

workflowId.description: Fallback run identifier for the default archive branch name when branchRunId is absent; defaults to the workflow instance id or task id.

branch.description: Branch name to create for the archive commit; defaults to openspec/archive/{changeId}/{first 8 chars of the run id}.

sameRepo.description: True when the OpenSpec source and target workspace are the same repository; the current branch is reused instead of creating a new archive branch.

publish.description: Whether the archive branch should be published as a PR downstream; defaults to true unless sameRepo is true.

forceAddPaths.description: Paths to force-add to the archive commit even if gitignored.

base.description: Base branch reported in the output for a downstream PR; not otherwise used by this task.

archived.description: Always true on the success path; failures raise instead.

changeId.description: OpenSpec change identifier that was archived.

archivePath.description: Repository-relative path of the archived change under openspec/changes/archive/; empty if no archive directory was found.

tasksCompleted.description: Number of previously-incomplete checklist items marked [x] in the change's tasks.md.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository the archive commit was made in.

branch.description: Archive branch name, or the current branch when sameRepo is true.

commit.description: Commit SHA of the archive commit.

publish.description: Whether the archive branch should be published as a PR downstream.

base.description: Base branch for a downstream PR.

title.description: Suggested PR title for the archive/implementation change.

body.description: Suggested PR body for the archive/implementation change.
